protocol.selection: 100 questions per source, first nonempty human and ChatGPT answer; fixed random order; no predictions used
protocol.four_class_score_mapping: P(AI creator) = P(ai_generated) + P(ai_humanized); threshold fixed at 0.5
protocol.evidence_boundary: Auxiliary binary OOD evaluation only. No labels distinguish polishing/humanization; it cannot validate four-class generalization. Unfiltered answer-length and explicit AI-marker differences remain.
